title: agent-config declaration
description: Declaration of a component's configuration keys and skill/agent dependencies, shipped as agent-config.json at a plugin's root.

$schema.description: URL of this schema, for editor validation; has no effect on processing.

version.description: Declaration format version. Currently must be 2.

schema.description: Configuration shape this component reads and writes; omit if the component has no configuration.

version.description: Version of this component's config shape, independent of the declaration format version.

keys.description: Configuration keys always in scope for this component, keyed by dot-path.

groups.description: Conditional sets of keys, each active only when its matcher is satisfied.

dependencies.description: Skills or agents this component requires, keyed by "<plugin>:<skill>" or a bare skill name for a skill outside any plugin.

registry.description: Opt-in registry behaviour overrides; omit entirely to accept defaults.

dirtyCheckout.description: Whether to refuse or allow operating against a dirty git checkout.

keyEntry.description: A single configuration key: what it means, where it is stored, and its default.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of what this key controls.

layer.description: Advisory hint for which config layer this key is expected to live in.

default.description: Default value used when the key is not set.

group.description: A set of keys that only apply when the matcher condition holds.

action.description: Id of the action to run to satisfy this group's keys; defaults to "onboard".

keys.description: Configuration keys that apply only when this group's matcher is satisfied, keyed by dot-path.

whenMatcher.description: Condition under which a group is active: a bare dot-path meaning "truthy", or a map of dot-path to required value(s), ANDed together.

oneOf.description: A dot-path that must be truthy.
Dot-paths that must each equal a scalar, or equal one of an array of scalars; all entries must match.

dependency.description: A required skill or agent and how to install it. Deliberately has no version field: dependencies are not pinned by version.

kind.description: Whether the dependency is a skill or an agent.

installSource.description: Where to get the dependency from: a marketplace plugin, or an action the depending component ships itself.

oneOf.description: Install from a plugin published on a marketplace.

marketplace.description: Id of the marketplace the plugin is published on.

url.description: URL of the marketplace or plugin source.

plugin.description: Name of the plugin to install.

oneOf.description: Install by running an action the depending component ships itself.

action.description: Id of the self-authored action that performs the install.
